description: This file defines a Python class 'VideoAndroid' for Android video playback integration in Kivy, utilizing Java classes via pyjnius, handling media playback, rotation, and rendering with OpenGL shaders.

classes.name: OnCompletionListener
classes.description: Java interface implementation for handling media completion events.

classes.name: OnErrorListener
classes.description: Java interface implementation for handling media error events.

classes.name: VideoAndroid
classes.description: A Kivy video widget class for Android, managing media playback, rotation, and rendering via OpenGL.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes media retriever, sets up SurfaceTexture, and prepares the media player for playback.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Releases media resources and resets internal state.

methods.name: _get_position
methods.description: Returns current playback position in seconds.

methods.name: _set_position
methods.description: Seeks to specified position in seconds.

methods.name: _get_duration
methods.description: Returns total duration of media in seconds.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and resets position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates texture from SurfaceTexture and triggers rendering.

methods.name: _do_eos
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream behavior based on 'eos' setting.
